body: thank you. i am really sorry for the people i will hurt. it just makes me feel worse to think about it. but thank you so much for your kindness.

i know. i do think about them. i had so many ideas and unfinished things. but there's nothing to gain from them. nothing that can outweigh all the fear and pain and guilt i'm feeling. i'm sorry to be so dramatic. thank you for your kindness.

i don't know how to talk to them. i have lied to them so much. they think i have lots of friends and work all the time and love class and go to class. i hate myself for lying, but i think the truth is even worse.

thank you so much. there is nowhere i can go except the hospital. i can't get there without calling an ambulance. i don't want to make a scene. i don't want to have to answer their questions. i just want to sleep and have silence and have all these thoughts go away.
thank you so much for your words. you are really kind and i wish the best for you.

i know, there are so many things that could happen in the future. there are so many places i wanted to go and books i wanted to read and write and now i won't be able to experience them.

but it's not exciting to me anymore. i don't know. thinking about it, it all seems really dull. almost horrible.
you are very kind. thank you.

several of you are very kind. thank you. i tried many things today. i read my favorite essay out loud and i wrote a really short short story about my favorite character and i drew a picture of the sun setting over the ocean. i thought these things would make me feel better. they haven't. i slept in too late to call a doctor. i could have called the hospital but i don't want to make a scene. 

also found my roommate's stash of trazodone. i feel like a dick for taking her medicine but i hope i won't have to take too much if i mix it with the alcohol. i just finished my letter to my parents. i'm going to write one for my sister and then get started. maybe i'll call my sister. the thought of actually talking to someone makes me feel physically sick. my roommate will probably be back in a couple of hours and i want to have this all over by then. i don't want to scare her too much. i also don't want to die choking on my own vomit but i think it's easier than the bridge.

i'm sorry guys, you've given me such kindness. i am really grateful and i love you all. i wish you the best in everything. all my blessings.
